title: 80-Minute JFK Assassination Walking and Van Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the story behind one of history's most debated events on this immersive 80-Minute JFK Assassination Walking & Van Tour. Led by an Emmy Award-winning investigative journalist and JFK researcher, this experience combines expert storytelling with exclusive multimedia presentations to bring November 22, 1963, to life.

Travel past the former Dallas Police Headquarters, where Jack Ruby shot Lee Harvey Oswald, before exploring historic Dealey Plaza and examining the evidence and enduring mysteries of the case.

Explore the infamous Grassy Knoll, separate fact from speculation, and gain a deeper understanding of why the assassination continues to fascinate millions, perfect for first-time visitors and lifelong JFK students alike. 

Whether you're new to the case or a longtime JFK enthusiast, this tour offers an engaging and thought-provoking experience unlike any other in Dallas, featuring custom video presentations that bring the evidence and timeline to life.
